title: IV. Four grades of the common status: divorce, loss of sense, privation of outward acts, defect of consummated glory
pass_a_gloss: (4) the defect of consummated glory pending the resumption belonging toward the body — which may stand as called so many belonging toward its mutations, plagues, and as it stood as wounds. (3) the privation of outward actions; (2) the loss belonging toward the sensitive part; (1) the soul's divorce from its body; Of this common status there stand as four grades: IV.
pass_b_english: IV. Of this common status there are four grades: (1) the soul's divorce from its body; (2) the loss of the sensitive part; (3) the privation of outward actions; (4) the defect of consummated glory pending the resumption of the body — which may be called so many of its mutations, plagues, and as it were wounds.
source_text: IV. Hujus communis status quatuor sunt gradus: 1. Animae a corpore suo divortium. 2. partis sensitivae amissio. 3. actionum ad extra privatio. 4. defectus gloriae consummatae per resumtionem corporis, quae totidem illius mutationes, plagae & quasi vulnera dici possunt.
